After 4% discount: 2073.60. Tax 6%: 124.416. Shipping 24. Total = 2222.016 → half-even → 2222.02 = 222202 cents. This exactly matches the approved limit. 

So payment amount = 222202 cents, within approved limit (exactly equal). Good.

Now check document-index files for clues about other worker? Let me check read-*.json. Actually those are just indexes of what was read. Let me quickly peek but not necessary.

Let me now create the draft JSON and post transaction.

Draft fields: request_id, vendor_id, currency, amount_cents.
